race.description: Slim And The Gold Coast Magazine Mdn Plate
race.comment: POETIC BELLE (9) is nearing the breakthrough, most recently beaten a head as a well-supported favourite over this trip at the Sunny Coast. Drawn wide but she should have enough toe to overcome and the 3kg claim gets her in at featherweight. Can get off the mark this time. I AM THAT GIRL (8) resumes for the Gollan camp and comes through some strong maidens. Has been fitted with a few trials, impressing in her most recent and keeps Jones from it. Can return with a bang. FIELD OF CLANS (7) was sound first-up when second at Ipswich and has the inside draw to help her build on that lightly raced profile. STORM OF MINTO (3) is a Pinatubo colt on debut for the Edmonds team. Has had mixed performances at the trials and is worth a market watch.
